title: Semi-Annual Maintenance for X-ray Generators and Cooling Units
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSEA.NAVSEA SHIPYARD.PUGET SOUND NAVAL SHIPYARD IMF
description_text: The contactor who performs the preventative maintenance and troubleshooting shall be an authorized service provider/technician on COMET Technologies USA, Inc. industrial x-ray equipment that uses a PC-based controller. The contractor shall provide a training certificate from COMET as proof of training/certification. The contractor must have a thorough knowledge of COMET Technologies USA, Inc. industrial x-ray equipment and maintenance requirements. The current machines used at TRIREFFAC are COMET x-ray model: MXR-320-26AX, serial number: 626630 (with standard controller) and COMET x-ray model: MXR-320/26, serial number: 1060031 (controlled with PC using COMET iVario control software).
